Definition: a male ass (from its dun red)
BiblicalUsage: Chamowr is the male ass, the working animal of the whole Bible. Abraham saddled his ass and took Isaac toward Moriah, the tenth commandment forbids coveting a neighbour's ass, Samson found a fresh jawbone and slew a thousand men with it, and Zechariah promises a king coming lowly and riding upon an ass.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the ass is the Bible's picture of ordinary service carrying extraordinary weight. It bears Abraham's wood, Samson's weapon, and at last the King Himself into Jerusalem. I hold that God delights to use the lowly and the overlooked, and this animal proves it from Genesis to Zechariah.
RelatedEvents: The Binding of Isaac; The Ten Commandments
